audit.why: Neither side has hard engage before 6, so lane is an even poke mirror through levels 1-5; it stays close at first item and Sona's auras edge ahead once she has two items.
Both spike at level 2 (two-spell combo online) and level 6 (competing AoE ults); Sona's item-scaling auras and Power Chord give her the late edge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across the whole row set: full phases[0-5].side said "Seraphine" and phases[6].side said "Skill", while content win[0-5] said "Skill" and win[6] said "Sona" — and the packet.levelChart matches content exactly.
audit.why: Content's whys/spikes are specific and grounded (E Beat Drop root follow-up, Power Chord stacking, Crescendo-vs-Encore range comparison) and match the packet; the full layer's blanket Seraphine-favored phases read as templated overconfidence.
audit.corrected: Flipped phases[0-5].side to "Skill" and phases[6].side to "Sona", rewrote each why to state the actual even-lane mechanics or Sona's late aura/Power Chord edge, matching content and the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing-interactions flagged two unmentioned facts: Sona's W (Aria of Perseverance) sustains through chip damage, and her Q (Hymn of Valor) applies on-hit so attack-speed items scale her poke past what armor alone answers.
audit.why: Both change how the trade math and itemization advice should read.

edits.before: - Sona Crescendo: matchup-defining — The stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Beat Drop banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
